text:
maya: PM for the 2026-03-20 inference blip is up. We need clear owners and tests: regression, load/soak, prompt sets, and a chaos drill. Short replies please.
owen: I can own the regression for the prefix/KV-cache edge-case. Will add unit + small integration harness.
li: I'll own the load/soak k6 job and GH Action schedule + Grafana dashboard. Target 5 business days.
samar: I'll lead the chaos drill focusing on KV eviction and replica failover. Tabletop then staging run.
eva: I'll expand prompt sets to include long-tail cache-miss triggers and model-swap quality checks. ETA 7 days.
oncall-bot: PM-4567 linked: https://pm.redwood/company/PM-4567
maya: Timelines recap: regression (owen) by +4 days; load job (li) by +5 days; prompts (eva) by +7 days; chaos drill (samar) next Wed staging. Please open GH issues/PRs and drop links here.
owen: Will open GH issue and PR for regression; include micro-eval asserting no quality drop on fallback.
li: Load action sketch:
```
name: incident-burst-load
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 4 * * 2'
jobs:
  run:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./ci/run_k6.sh --script k6/burst_short_requests.js --rate 10000
```
li: Dashboard + alerts aim: next Tue.
samar: Chaos success criteria: fallback routing <30s, error spike limited, 95p latency within 2x. I'll draft playbook in #eng-oncall.
eva: Prompt-set repo: github.com/redwood-inference/evals/prompt-sets/pm-4567-cache-edge. PR will include pass thresholds.
maya: Also ask eng-sre to add a recurring KV-eviction spike detection. @li please coordinate.
li: Will file ops ticket and sync with eng-sre.
maya: Weekly follow-up Friday 9am PT to verify staging canary. Drop quick status comments in the GH issue when PRs are created. Thanks. :thumbsup:
